title: Unit Event — Stick to Your Faith — Episode6 What We Can't Give Up

meta.Episode: Episode6 — What We Can't Give Up
meta.Event Outline: Leo/need are gearing up to make their professional debut. As their label considers how best to market the band, Mr. Shindo asks the girls what music they aspire to.

rows.Line: Backstage

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
If you say so...!
I guess playing the bass isn't really that interesting, huh?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I get it. I'm sorry. I'll stop being so pushy...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: But can I just ask why you don't wanna play anymore...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I just don't think it's a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Why not?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
I always do this...
I get so caught up in what I'm doing that I lose track of everything else.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Which ends up upsetting the people around me. I made one of my classmates really sad just the other day...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I just don't think it's a good idea for me to play the bass.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I think I know what you mean about upsetting others, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: My family comes from a long line of flower artists. It's actually pretty famous.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: When I was little, I told my mom that I was gonna become a great artist just like her. She seemed so proud of me.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: But after I saw your dad perform in that show, I started playing music and haven't looked back since...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: There's this flower exhibition that I always entered pieces into every year since I was a kid...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: But I started focusing so much on performing in shows that I stopped making anything for it.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: My mom didn't ask me any questions, but she did seem really sad...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: She did...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: If I tried to have my dessert and eat it too back then, I don't think either thing would've gone well for me.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Granted, I asked myself a ton whether or not it was okay for me to make my mom feel the way she did.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I know I would've regretted turning in something I wasn't happy with.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: But I also never meant to upset everyone...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Then, why?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Why did you decide to keep playing music?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Well, after giving it a lot of thought, I found my answer.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I realized that I couldn't give up my music.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: You couldn't give it up...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Yeah. I think anyone would know what I'm talking about. We all have something we really love that we're gonna pursue no matter what anyone says.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: For me, that's music.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Plus, people who just go their own way have this really cool aura to them... Your dad is the one who helped me realize that, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: My dad...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Yeah. The first time I saw him play, I thought he was the coolest person in the world.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I asked myself a bunch of times why I felt that way back then...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: But I'm pretty sure it's because he stays true to himself and does what he loves.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (He does what he loves...?)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: People who do what they love and put everything they have into making their dreams come true have this dazzling aura.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: They do...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I think so. I mean, my mom was the same way.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: My mom as a person is pretty quiet and calm, but she always looks so cool when she's working with flowers.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: And I think that's because the art she creates means everything to her. That's the thing she'll never let anyone take away from her...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: My mom and I differ on that thing now, but I appreciate the fact that she's really passionate about what she does...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: So, I...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I don't want to disrespect the people I just mentioned by not trying my hardest.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Your dad, Shiho, and my mom...
I want to be true to my feelings like they are. I want to have that same dazzling aura.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Doing what you love gives you an aura...?)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I know, my words don't paint a good picture...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
But Shiho!
You're gonna see our show, right?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
I hope you like what you see!
I promise to show you exactly what I meant just now.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I think it's time...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: What did you and Kuno talk about?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: A lot. She taught me how to play her bass, and explained how she ended up being in a band...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Really?
What did she tell you?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: She told me...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: She told me she's gonna let her performance do the talking.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, we'll need to give it the attention it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Here we go!
